Vorssaint uses Automation to move files in Finder, send items to the Trash and open Terminal commands when you ask for Homebrew actions.
Vorssaint taps individual app audio only to adjust each app's volume in the mixer. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Vorssaint uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Vorssaint records your microphone only when you turn it on for a screen recording. The audio stays on your Mac unless you choose to create a temporary link.
Vorssaint shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Vorssaint accesses Downloads only when you use the video downloader or ask it to review, organize or trash confirmed WhatsApp files.
Vorssaint saves videos or organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads only in a destination folder you explicitly choose.
